anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Heard only by the perfect: this month is for you a beginning.

pass_a_gloss: it is clear that not for all the people then was that month a beginning of months but only for Moses and Aaron, toward whom it has been said. For one must perfectly bid farewell to the creation and this world so as to grasp that one has almost been born another than what one was, so that one may be able to hear: This month is for you beginning of months…
pass_b_english: It is clear that that month was not then a beginning of months for all the people, but only for Moses and Aaron, to whom it was said. For one must perfectly renounce the creation and this world, so as to grasp that one has almost been born another than what one was — in order to be able to hear: This month is for you a beginning of months; it is first for you among the months of the year.
source_text: δῆλον ὅτι οὐ παντὶ τῷ λαῷ τότε ἐκεῖνος ἦν ὁ μὴν ἀρχὴ μηνῶν ἀλλὰ [μό]νοις Μωϋσῇ καὶ Ἀαρών, π[ρὸς οὓ]ς εἴρηται. Τελείως γὰρ ἀπ[οτά]ξασθαι τῇ κτίσει καὶ τῷ κ[όσ]μῳ τούτῳ δεῖ ὡς καταλαμβ[άν]ειν ὅτι σχεδὸν ἕτερος γ[εγ]ένηταί τις παρ’ ὃ ἦν, ἵνα [ἀ]κοῦσαι δυνηθῇ· Ὁ μὴ[ν] οὗτο[ς σοὶ] ἀρχὴ μηνῶν, πρῶτ[ός ἐσ]τι [σοὶ ἐ]ν τοῖς μησὶν το[ῦ ἐνι]α[υτο]ῦ.
